text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Some time has passed since the start of 
the training camp.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (The hypoxic training continued.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Day after day. Every single day... I kept 
at it.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ……Mmm—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like it's about time. 
..............."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(All the training preparations we've been 
doing up until now...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Equipment check. Menu check. All that's 
left is a thorough stretch... or so it was 
supposed to be.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Lately, I've picked up one more habit.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaaaale...... Phewwwwww......

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Find somewhere with good ventilation if 
possible. And take long, deep breaths.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The sensation of my lungs expanding, and 
the sheer comfort of air circulating 
deeply through my body.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(With reverence... and reluctance. Savor 
every... last drop of it.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'm alright.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (The time I spend on new habits is...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...It feels like it's getting little by 
little, longer.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Once the transfer is complete, I put on 
the mask. That moment it slips over my 
face, just for a second...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (—A chilly ache grips deep in my chest.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. ...I'll be in 
your care.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. ...First up is the forest trail 
sprint.

Yeah. ...First, let's start with the 
forest path sprint.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I listen to Trainer's instructions. Time, 
repetitions, and things to watch out for.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Once that's over, and the signal is 
given...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (All that's left is to just keep going.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Dive. Keep diving deeper. Out of breath, 
lungs crushed, punishing myself until my 
heart feels ready to burst.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Just keep diving deeper.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Sometimes, my vision goes dark and 
blurry. When that happens, I deliberately 
plant my feet harder.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(When I do that, my aching muscles scream 
in piercing pain— and in return, my mind 
snaps clear.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Guh, ...urgh, ...gahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
("Focus on exhaling rather than inhaling." 
"If you feel too weak, signal with your 
right hand." "If you feel anything else 
unusual, use your left hand"—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(All the countless, endless pieces of 
advice Trainer gave me keep swirling 
through my head.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Maybe it's not about the details.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...I'm remembering that voice.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haa...!! Ha, h-ha, haa, haa, ...wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I hear hypoxic training boosts metabolism 
quite a bit, too.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(By the time it's over, I'm always 
drenched in sweat, like someone dumped a 
bucket of water over my head.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, lately... ...it's been 
especially hard to catch my breath.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Th-Thank... you very much...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (I couldn't say a proper farewell.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...I feel... so sorry.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The long, long summer training camp is 
finally drawing to a close. ...As for 
Believe—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to go out of my way to 
check something like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her exhaustion was painfully obvious. Even 
for a girl who had stoically endured 
grueling menus and agonizing days with an 
unfazed expression.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Believe is likely pushing 
through each day solely on her 
extraordinary mental fortitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, with just a little rest, the sun 
will rise again. ――And once more, the time 
for training will arrive."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, Believe endured that day as 
well. Taking shallow breaths, drenched in 
sweat, yet she still—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Phew, ……phew, phew, phew……!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Endure, endure, and hold out to the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enduring, enduring, persevering through it 
all, and then—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
............Ah. Break time is over, isn't 
it? My mask...—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, no.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Um... no. ...Um—wha... why?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
My body... feels strange... Why won't 
it... move...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She finally couldn't endure it anymore. 
...The moment that thought crossed my 
mind, a lump formed in my throat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is true. Suffering is hard for 
anyone. Pain is hard, too. Hard things are 
scary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Anyone could. ...Even Believe.
choice_data_list:
(Enough. Enough, it's all right now, 
Believe)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's enough. You've done plenty. Get 
some rest." ...That's what I thought about 
telling her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to push yourself. You don't 
have to keep trying so hard. Just do what 
you can in the Sprinters Stakes, and run 
with the mindset of simply enjoying it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, I intended to tell her gently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not until I look her properly in the face.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Nngh, damn it. Damn it, damn it... 
Move...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Move, damn it...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't a hint of resignation or 
running away. Not even the slightest trace 
could be seen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was simply filled with frustration. 
Vexed, she kept scolding herself.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ngh, I'm going to—!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I... don't need anything else.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I don't need praise. I don't need glory. I 
don't need to be the center of an era.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I don't need any awards. I don't need 
anything, anything else at all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It's just, ah…… I just――

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —I want to do the best job possible.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to look back and truly 
feel, 'I did it!' I want to do the 
absolute best work, with no regrets at 
all!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I have to do the greatest... job. A race 
where I'm the fastest—the absolute 
fastest...!!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So... that's why, Trainer. Please, I'm 
counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Please. Please let me run.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Please, let me do the job.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: To me, ...—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Please tell me to "do my best."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Please.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Please—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I grit my back teeth tightly, firmly, 
harder still. So hard it felt as if they 
might shatter. —And in doing so, I crushed 
my own weakness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You don't have to push yourself." "You 
don't have to try so hard." Wanting to 
whisper such gentle words to her... 
...What foolishness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying things like "It's too painful to 
watch" was nothing more than forcing my 
own feelings onto her. It was utterly 
foolish of me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In that case. Breaking Believe's 
convictions right here is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No matter what, I can't let that happen.

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list: Do your best!! Come on, Believe!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, ...ngh!!
choice_data_list: You can do it!! I know you can, Believe!!
Do your best!! You can do it, Believe!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Believe began running once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
*Guh...*!! Ngh... *huff, huff, 
wheeze...*!!
choice_data_list: Hang in there, hold out!! Believe!!
Hang in there, hold on!! Believe!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... ghh...――

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Gaaah...!! Haa... haa... haaaah......

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Pheeewww.........

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...Yes.
choice_data_list:
Completed the entire routine in low 
oxygen!!

Completed the entire routine in low 
oxygen!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
These hellish days aren't over yet. If I 
fall asleep, tomorrow will come, and the 
training will begin all over again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, neither had any doubts left. 
Taking each other's hands, they dove deep, 
plunging straight into a world rife with 
pain and suffering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that lies something we desperately, 
desperately want to seize. —Because only 
the two of us know that.
